So I'm I it doesn't compute to me'); update all three instances to the correct timestamp. This is, Corey with Ions.') — the actual customer line occurs at 00:46-00:48; fix the ts. Optionally strengthen the trajectory narrative by tracing the business-model interrogation back to the rep's premature 'bill swap' program pitch at 01:34 (delivered before verify/bill sections), which is the likely root cause of the downstream trust spiral — this is currently only addressed as a symptom (slow escape-hatch deployment) rather than at its origin.
